profile.headline: Software Engineer chez Apple
profile.summary:
Challenge-driven, articulate and passionate senior software developer who is committed to get things done. Strong in design and user experience problem solving, has worked extensively on both large Java enterprise application platforms and on client / desktop applications, on both the Windows and Mac OS X platforms. Excels in developing requirements specifications and project development schedules, is extremely well organized, possesses excellent written and verbal communication skills, in both French and English.

Specialties: Operating Systems:
- Linux/Unix, Windows XP, Vista and Mac OS X

Languages:
- Java, JSP, C/C++/Objective-C and HTML/XML/Javascript

Environments:
- J2EE/WebLogic, Visual Studio 2005-2010/COM/DCOM and Xcode/Cocoa

Databases:
- Oracle, MYSQL, MSSQL and Sqlite

positions.title: Self-employed Mac developer
positions.description:
I came across an opportunity to work as a contract developer for a small software company that sells several Mac OS X and iOS applications. Specifically, I was hired to work on their flagship product, PDFpen, which is a Mac OS X PDF annotations editor. The company is celebrating its 10-year anniversary this year, so they have been around for a while and have an excellent reputation in the Mac software development community. As the primary developer on the product for the last two years, I have successfully contributed to a steady stream of software updates to the product that have seen the addition of many new features and enhancements to existing ones, correction of bugs and overall improvements to the performance and memory requirements of the application.

- Added support for new Apple technologies, such as iCloud support, ARC conversion and sandboxing. PDFpen was one of the very first Mac applications on the Mac App Store to offer iCloud support in OS X 10.7, including providing our own custom iCloud file browser panel (since OS X 10.7 didn’t provide any built-in user interface support for iCloud)
- Added support for new features in the PDF specification, such as support for PDF portfolios and file attachments.
- Lead the effort to streamline the localization process of the application, and helped optimize various other development processes in the company.
- Helped define the application’s upcoming (and just recently released) PDFpen 6 major version upgrade feature list and implemented several of the major new improvements, such as an entirely redesigned document editing bar user interface and a greatly expanded set of features to work with and track a document’s annotations.

positions.title: Team Lead & Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
In early 2008, I was tasked with investigating the feasibility of developing a Mac-compatible version of our flagship Windows security software suite.

- Architected and implemented a prototype Mac Antivirus client software with both on-demand and real-time malware protection capabilities using above-mentioned 3rd party antimalware SDK.
- Assembled and lead a brand new team of software developers (all new hires) through the successful planning, development, testing and release to production of two successive versions of a Mac security software suite, successfully applying agile development practices throughout.
- Played a key role in the design and development of several essential features of the application, including user interface design and specification, security model and implementation of the inter-process communication protocols across the various components of the application suite and the complete development of a stand-alone application uninstall utility.
- Coordinated with various other teams across the company for project management, quality assurance, professional services and operations to ensure smooth and successful software releases, with no surprises.
- Generally acknowledged as the "go-to" person for all Mac-related questions, technical or otherwise, provided extensive assistance to all members of the team and to other employees across the company for help with working with Mac hardware and software.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Following the successful delivery of the 2.0 release of the MSDP application in November 2007, I transitioned to another team where I worked as a C++ developer on the Servicepoint Dashboard (SPD) application, a small desktop application that interacts with the MSDP backend.

- Designed, developed and tested an essential new "campaign script" capability. This feature provides SPD with the ability to silently download "script bundles" from the MSDP back-end, unpack them and run the scripts in a secured application scripting engine through which various aspects of the SPD application functionality is exposed via a scripting API.
- Designed, developed and tested a structured persistent storage capability. This feature provides SPD with the ability to expose persistent data storage to various SPD application components via a simple to use scripting storage API. Internally, persistent data storage is implemented on top an encapsulated sqlite database engine.
- Designed, developed and tested a SPD user profile migration capability that allows the seamless migration of existing SPD user profiles across ISP migrations. User profiles consist of branded Windows registry settings, as well as personal data and log files.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
I was originally hired as a senior Java software developer, to be part of a new Products Development team that was assembled to design and deliver the company's next-generation back-end services platform, the Managed Service Delivery Platform (MSDP), a new Java / WebLogic-based application platform tied to an Oracle database. This was to be a total rewrite of several of the company's legacy back-end services (a hodge-podge of diverse Perl, PHP and C modules with an array of MYSQL databases).

- Re-architected the Account Provision Service, which was originally written as a Web Objects stand-alone application and converted it into a SOAP-based web service that ran under WebLogic 8.1, along with the rest of the MSDP application.
- Architected the entire presentation layer of the MSDP application, using the Struts web MVC framework, which consists of 3 different web portals, each one geared at a specific target audience: an Operations Portal for the Ops team, a Provider Portal for the Professional Services team and a Supplier Portal for the Products development team.
- Designed, developed and tested several of the major functional areas in each one of the above-mentioned web portals, namely the most complex Campaign Management section of the Provider Portal, which provides the ability to define and manage campaigns, as well as their various scheduling and targeting rules. Campaigns are individual HTML & script bundles that can be retrieved and displayed by a small desktop application, based on the provided scheduling and targeting rules.
- Designed, developed and tested a server-side implementation of fulfillment campaigns, including the required database schema changes, new business logic and new web portal functionality. Fulfillment campaigns are a specialized kind of campaigns that allow the targeted delivery of software fulfillment campaigns, which in turn facilitate the download and installation of user's subscription-based software.

positions.title: Team & Tech Lead
positions.description:
In my last year of employment at CGI, I have been actively involved on the Bell.ca Modernization project (migration of the Bell.ca site from a WLS 6.0 platform to WebLogic Portal 8.1 platform). This project was not simply a 'migration' effort, unlike the name suggests, but actually much more of a 'redesign and improve' effort. 
This was a very important and highly visible project for Bell Canada and it gave me the opportunity to gain a deep understanding and knowledge of WebLogic 8.1 Portal and related technologies.

- Worked with a team of senior software developers on the project analysis & exploration phase of the Bell.ca Web Site modernization, from the BEA WLS 6.0 platform to the WLS 8.1 Portal Server platform.
Designed a reusable Flexible Buying workflow business-processing framework.
- Worked as tech lead with a team of software developers in the development of the framework and the implementation of several application/business flows using the new framework.
- Designed a reusable eForms generation and management framework, based on and extending, the workflow engine that was designed and delivered in the previous project phase.
- Led a team of software developers in the development of the framework and the migration of existing forms-based applications.
- Managed and coordinated all aspects of the project delivery schedule.
- Acted as technical mentor for newly hired university graduates.

positions.title: Team & Tech Lead
positions.description:
Prior to joining the Bell.ca Modernization project, I have worked on several different projects, many of them dealing with specific aspects of Java technology (EJBs, Struts, JSPs & Servlets, JDBC, XML and so on):

- Designed several enhancements to the Online Customer Information (OCI) application in order to improve customer productivity.
- Designed a Web-based application that Bell customer representatives use to gather customer profile information that is later used to send targeted email content & newsletters (Permission Marketing).
- Designed a credit card based billing application for Bell Canada's Web Site Hosting service customers.
- Designed and developed the Bell Corporate Security Access Control Web Site that allows Bell employees to request, manage and release NT accounts and associated access permissions.
- Designed and developed a generic, database-independent data access framework that provides a common implementation of auditing, record locking, delete / restore / purge functionality.
- Designed and developed a generic Web forms and lists management framework that served to provide much of the user interface for the CSAC web site and which was later reused by many other projects / Web sites.
- Designed and developed the BCE Connexions employee portal Web Site which provides news articles, press clippings, employee directory, employee surveys, search engine, classified ads, etc.
- Designed and developed the Content Management tool that manages the entire BCE Connexions Web Site.
